Everything is built, tested end-to-end, and ready for review. The broker will start the app on `http://maker:4000` with a fresh database.

## What I built

A single-user **bookmark manager** — Node + Express, SQLite storage, vanilla-JS SPA with a clean, readability-first UI (light/dark/auto).

**Every feature you asked for, verified working:**

| Feature | Status |
|---|---|
| Auto-fetch title, description, favicon, preview image | ✅ live fetch on paste; all fields editable + re-fetch button |
| Read-later status | ✅ toggle + dedicated view |
| Reversible archiving | ✅ archive/unarchive with an **Undo** toast |
| Notes | ✅ per-bookmark, shown on cards |
| Sorting | ✅ newest/oldest/recently-updated/title/domain |
| Bulk actions | ✅ select → read-later, archive, add/remove tag, delete |
| Strong search | ✅ AND terms, `"exact phrases"`, `-exclusions`, `tag:`, `site:`, `is:read-later/archived/snapshot` |
| No duplicate URLs | ✅ normalized key (ignores `http`/`https`, `www.`, trailing slash, tracking params) → re-saving **opens the existing bookmark** |
| Saved filter combinations | ✅ save query+scope+sort, one-click reapply |
| Page snapshots | ✅ Playwright captures full-page PNG + saved HTML per bookmark |
| Import / export | ✅ JSON (full fidelity) **and** browser-HTML (Netscape); import dedups; folders → tags |
| Display preferences | ✅ theme, grid/list, density, default sort, show/hide previews |

**How I verified it:** ran the server on a test port and exercised every API (dedup across http/https/www/trailing/tracking, all six search operators, bulk archive/tag, saved filters, prefs, JSON+HTML export, HTML import with folder-tags and dedup, live metadata fetch, and a real Chromium snapshot served over HTTP). Then drove the actual UI with a headless browser — page renders with **no console errors**, the readiness marker is set, autofetch populates the form, and live search filters correctly. Finally confirmed `npm start` boots cleanly on port 4000.

**A couple of notes:**
- Data lives in `/work/data` (SQLite + snapshot files); I left it empty so you start fresh.
- Keyboard shortcuts: `n` to add a bookmark, `/` to focus search.
- The app has no login (single-user, as agreed) — it's ready to use immediately at `http://maker:4000`.

Want me to add anything next — e.g. a bookmarklet/browser-extension endpoint for one-click saving, favorites/pinning, or duplicate-URL merging tools?
